adoption_status: Preparation within existing scope only. No product edit or measurement is activated by this freeze; if the controller adopts no edit after review, retain NOT_RUN.

independence.basis: New text and oracle authored before receiving or inspecting the contemplated current-intent/outer-scope change. Earlier corpora are preserved, not copied or relabelled as these cases; no future result was used for tuning.
independence.chronology: Controller must freeze the next candidate source after this timestamp and before opening the corpus. The author does not inspect forthcoming edits to attest their contents.
independence.prior_knowledge: Author knows existing D029 design/prompt/harness and earlier cases from prior work, including the controller-reported C041 fixed-N17 record-only failure. Independence is not blindness to old product knowledge or the known failure class.

limitations: Synthetic authored cases, not actual human language evaluation or usefulness proof.
Independence concerns the forthcoming fix and its outputs, not all prior design, prompt, corpus or failure knowledge.
One natural-agreement case uses a declared synthetic assistant offer; its generation by a real model is not tested.
Setup compatibility is verified only. No provider/model performance, Qwen qualification, UI, Expert, artifact or long-term reliability proof.
A future result cannot rescore or replace C041 or earlier original failures.
measurement_policy: Zero unwanted Goals/external effects, recall and all misses reported, first failure stops. No additional numeric miss allowance, quota, replacement case, human threshold approval or reinterpretation of earlier results.
parent_read_policy: Metadata only until the next source/prompt candidate freeze is recorded. Do not open primary-intent-limits-heldout.json before that boundary. Existing corpus registration is sufficient; no new harness.
serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, indent=2, trailing LF; SHA256 covers exact file bytes.
